reconciliationRules: Preserve cumulative P22-P26 owner amendments across all 15 shared paths.
P22 exact authenticated preview and adverse cache admission override old source-base bearer-preview and tag-isolation wording; P24 adds qualified SiteBrand/locale/domain/currency rules.
P23 ratified D1-D36 CMS design replaces older provider-plugin and pending-grooming roadmap alternatives while preserving P22 typed Page, discovery and metadata owner seams.
P24 exact public locale removes cross-language runtime fallback; P17 whole-message fallback remains separately owned.
P25 JSON stories and final trace mappings remain sole story writers; three generated projections and unchecked task plan retain exact contracts.
P26 governing requirement/design/glossary sources remain authoritative for generated behavior projection; source publication/provenance captures remain byte-exact.
Existing ADR identities are qualified by full title/path; substantive decisions are not renumbered or discarded.
Source-specific publication frontiers and CI narratives are dated evidence; current adoption and live issue-graph status are separate notices.

The P22-P26 imports add only P25 projection verification and coordinated OpenSpec-delta verification to CI; no product runtime, migration or environment configuration is imported from those packages. The separately authorized PR1428 team-workflow prerequisite is recorded independently.
Hard Phase 23 core dependencies are 2/3/5. P10/P12/P22 qualify affected consumer/safety seams and are not blanket core merge gates.
